rows.bounded_recovery: The immutable Vesper source worktree was addressed by exact literal paths and remained read-only while the templates were inspected.
rows.failed_witness: The first read-only template lookup targeted the sparse Lyren checkout, where the three Vesper final-only templates were absent. The lookup produced no complete template read and earned zero closeout credit.
rows.title: sparse Lyren lane did not materialize predecessor-only closeout templates

rows.bounded_recovery: Each immutable template was reread separately with literal paths and an explicit file-sized output bound through EOF.
rows.failed_witness: A combined read-only display of the builder, validator, and final test was truncated before all files reached EOF. The partial display earned zero complete-read credit.
rows.title: combined three-template display exceeded the bounded output budget

rows.bounded_recovery: The range helper was abandoned and the three immutable files were read individually as literal raw files through EOF.
rows.failed_witness: The first bounded-range helper failed before reading content because subtraction was applied to an object array. It earned zero template-read credit.
rows.title: PowerShell range helper parsed an array expression incorrectly

rows.bounded_recovery: The recovery checks exact owner, route, delivery, runner-prefix, and baton-path fields in current final paths while preserving historical rejection evidence and opaque hashes.
rows.failed_witness: The first staged audit treated a deliberately retained historical Vesper Rowan rejection row and the digits 8388 inside SHA-256 values as current stale-state findings. It earned zero stale-label or count-hygiene credit.
rows.title: precommit stale scan used context-free substring patterns

rows.bounded_recovery: No mutation or canonical action was retried; the recovery uses a bounded scalar wrapper around a fresh read-only preflight and reports its exit code explicitly.
rows.failed_witness: The initial read-only staged-manifest replay reached its execution bound without an attributable output or retained exit scalar. It earns zero manifest-replay credit even though it may have progressed internally.
rows.title: first manifest preflight returned no attributable scalar receipt

rows.bounded_recovery: The fragile f-string was removed; a plain loop now constructs index or HEAD blob specs without nested quote escaping.
rows.failed_witness: The first scalar diagnostic wrapper stopped at Python parse time because shell-level backslashes reached the inline f-string. It earned zero replay credit.
rows.title: manifest diagnostic wrapper injected escaped quotes into a Python f-string
